reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its main activity is an operational demonstration of the OnePay wallet, showing account login or creation and wallet functions such as transfers, requests and statements. Although the description promotes registration and calls OneCoin "THE NEW BITCOIN," the supplied video does not show a specific guaranteed-return claim, sensitive-data takeover request, payment-for-guidance flow or other concrete deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: OnePay is OneCoin's own eWallet payment system.
You can see and manage all your funds in your OnePay eWallet.
OnePayments is a secure, fast and easy way to send and receive funds globally registered.

opening.argument: The registration pathway is tied directly to an investment-framed pitch, not merely neutral wallet education. The description calls OneCoin “THE NEW BITCOIN,” immediately supplies a signup address, and asks whether the viewer wished they had invested. That combination encourages the viewer to register in response to the implied opportunity to get in on a Bitcoin-like asset. The tutorial’s wallet context reinforces that participation involves handling money: OnePay is described as OneCoin’s own eWallet and as making it easy to upload and withdraw money. The evidence therefore supports treating the registration invitation as an acquisition pathway for an investment-related asset, even though it does not state a precise return percentage.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical Have you Ever wished you had invested in ...
OnePay is OneCoin's own eWallet payment system.
makes it easy to upload and withdraw money

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a tutorial does not neutralize the surrounding solicitation. The supplied description does not merely identify a product: it labels OneCoin “THE NEW BITCOIN,” provides a signup route, and invokes the regret of not having invested. The wallet demonstration then shows the practical account and money-handling pathway. Thus, the absence of a guaranteed percentage does not answer the central concern: viewers are being steered toward participation in an investment-framed asset.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical Have you Ever wished you had invested in ...
This screen offers you the option to create a OnePay account, or if you already have a OnePay account, you can log in.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The description is promotional, but its wording does not establish token purchase, appreciation, dividends, or any promised return. “THE NEW BITCOIN” is a comparison, and “Have you Ever wished you had invested in ...” is incomplete; neither quote identifies what a registrant receives or how money will grow. The ASR only describes an eWallet and its functions, so the cited material does not prove an investment solicitation mechanism.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical Have you Ever wished you had invested in ...
You can see and manage all your funds in your OnePay eWallet.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: an external signup address, crypto-style branding, an account flow, and a funding-capable wallet. The description pairs “THE NEW BITCOIN” with “Register At,” while the tutorial is explicitly titled “UPGRADE PACKAGE.” The recorded explanation says users can create or log into the OnePay account, upload and withdraw money, and manage funds; the frames also present “Create OnePay account,” “Log In to my OnePay account,” and a “Deposit” function. Taken together, this is more than a passive explanation of technology: it normalizes registration and financial participation around a Bitcoin-like asset without supplying independently verifiable investment safeguards or limits.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical
makes it easy to upload and withdraw money

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side isolates each signal and calls it ordinary functionality, but the relevant issue is their combination. “Upgrade package,” external registration, wallet access, and deposit capability create a participation funnel around the promoted asset. A scam need not display a guaranteed-return number when it uses investment-style branding and financial onboarding to encourage users to enter the system.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are genuine financial-interface signals, but they remain ambiguous. The title “UPGRADE PACKAGE” does not say what is purchased or what return follows, and the frame showing account and deposit controls does not show a completed payment, token purchase, or deceptive outcome. The ASR describes ordinary wallet capabilities, not investment earnings or a false promise.

citations.quote: You can see and manage all your funds in your OnePay eWallet.

opening.argument: The apparent tutorial role functions as promotional onboarding. The presentation is labeled “TUTORIAL 7 'UPGRADE PACKAGE',” then directs attention to OnePay login and account-creation controls and to wallet features for deposits, transfers, requests, and currency exchange. The description supplies a registration link while presenting OneCoin as “THE NEW BITCOIN.” That structure teaches the viewer how to enter and operate the promoted financial ecosystem, rather than offering detached technical analysis. Its practical effect is to reduce friction for participation in an investment-framed product, even without an explicit guarantee.

citations.quote: ONECOIN THE NEW BITCOIN Register At : https://www.onelife.eu/signup/karamFaical

rebuttal.rebuttal: The word “tutorial” describes format, not purpose. Here the format is an “UPGRADE PACKAGE” walkthrough that shows how to access the OnePay account and its money functions, while the description gives viewers a signup route and investment-oriented framing. That is promotional onboarding in substance: the viewer is shown how to participate, not merely told how payment software works.

citations.quote: Have you Ever wished you had invested in ...

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The frames establish a walkthrough of interface controls, but they do not establish that the walkthrough is an investment pitch. “Upgrade package” could describe a software or account tier, and the visible options are generic wallet functions such as transfers, statements, and account settings. The description’s registration link and Bitcoin comparison show promotion, but not that the video promises appreciation or requires an investment.
